claims: "For service after 17 August 1993 (which is everyone who started in the last 33 years)"
whys: The figure 33 is hard-coded and goes stale on 17 Aug 2027. The ATO rule also turns on the date the service was performed, not the date the person started, so someone who started earlier still has post-1993 service taxed at marginal rates.
